content: Aarav Sharma called DCoders to check the status of his auto policy, suspecting it had expired. Insurance agent Suresh Deshmukh verified the policy number AP-001234 and confirmed the policy expired on March 10. Suresh noted that a renewal notice was sent but missed, and offered Aarav the opportunity to renew the policy immediately.

action_items: Decide whether to renew the auto policy on the same day
